notes:
Fix empty-state message staying frozen in the wrong language after a language switch. The 'Get started' heading and subtitle (both the #segments-list and the Timeline-editor stage) were rendered as bare ${t0.empty_title}/${t0.empty_sub} interpolations with no data-i18n attribute, so setAppLang could never re-translate them — only the Create-Scene button (data-i18n-btn) updated. Because the empty state paints ~1.5s after load (loadSegments retry delay), after the deferred auto-detect setAppLang fires, you could end up with the EN toggle active but a Japanese heading (or vice-versa). Added data-i18n="empty_title" / data-i18n="empty_sub" to both

tags so every language switch fully repaints the empty state regardless of when it was first drawn. Same data-i18n gap class as the v1.4.66 scene-card fix.
